app.title: Vote Wallet
app.subtitle: National Electoral Commission Digital Voting Portal

login.desc: Enter your National Voter ID to access your confidential electronic ballot.
login.help: Need help finding your voter ID? Check your electoral photo card or contact your constituency office.

otp.desc: A 6-digit secure code was sent to your registered mobile ending in

identity.desc: Confirm your identity details before entering the confidential voting booth.

consent.desc: To ensure one-citizen, one-vote integrity, facial liveness and biometric matching are conducted in volatile RAM memory only.
consent.bullet1: Biometric templates are decrypted in volatile memory and never stored on disk.
consent.bullet2: Zero-Knowledge isolation separates your citizen identity from your encrypted ballot.
consent.bullet3: Post-election statutory purge permanently cleanses all temporary biometric tokens.

face.desc: Align your face in the oval frame and follow the interactive prompts.
face.failed: Biometric match did not meet confidence threshold. Please retry.

fingerprint.desc: Touch your device's biometric sensor or security key to complete factor 3 authentication.

ballot.desc: Select one candidate from your constituency slate. Your choice is encrypted with trustee public keys before transmission.

review.desc: Please carefully review your selection. Once sealed and cast, ballots cannot be altered or undone.
review.sealingNotice: Your ballot will be sealed with AES-256-GCM encryption and recorded in the isolated Ballot Box.

receipt.desc: Your vote has been cryptographically recorded in the national ballot box and anchored in the Merkle audit tree.
